name: Dynamic Alerts
author: Fadi Haddad

sections.description: Dynamic Alerts allows you to create a dynamic, customizable notification bar for your WordPress site. Add up to four messages with individual links, control speed, direction, font size, and enable or disable the bar from the admin panel.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dynamic-alerts directory, or install via the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Dynamic Alerts to configure your notifications.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the font size?

Yes, you can set the font size in the settings page.

How many messages can I add?

You can add up to four messages, each with an optional link.

Can I hide the notification bar?

Yes, you can enable or disable the bar from the settings page.
